cards.name: Bloat
cards.summary: Liquify brush that inflates vector paths: anchor points under the circular brush are pushed away from the cursor centre, so the edge balloons outward into a rounded bulge (or, with the brush centre outside a shape, gets pushed in). The effect keeps growing while the mouse button is held and edits the path geometry directly, adding anchor points.
cards.how: Pick Bloat from the Width tool flyout (the Width Tool group of the Default toolbar). Select the objects you want to change first; with nothing selected the brush distorts every unlocked object under it. Click and hold over the outline (longer hold = bigger bulge) or drag along it. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush on the fly; double-click the tool icon for the options dialog (brush width, height, angle, intensity, pressure pen, and the Detail / Simplify settings that decide how many points get added). Brush centre inside the shape bulges the edge out, centre outside dents it.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Bloat Tool") only makes Bloat the active tool (the harvest read it back with app.getSelectedToolName()); the press-and-hold brush stroke has no DOM call. Scripted substitute for a whole-object bloat: the Pucker & Bloat live effect with a positive value, item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Punk and Bloat"><Dict data="R d_factor N"/></LiveEffect>') with N positive (the Bloat side; harvest id 'Live Pucker & Bloat', key d_factor), or move PathPoint.anchor / leftDirection / rightDirection outward by script.
use_for: puffy, inflated lettering and cartoon shapes (after Type > Create Outlines)
organic blob and bubble shapes from simple circles and rectangles
local bulges on icons and illustrations, e.g. a swollen cheek or a bulging can
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
edits that must stay editable or repeatable: the distortion is baked into the path; use Effect > Distort & Transform > Pucker & Bloat (positive value) as a live effect
print-ready logos: each pass adds many anchor points; clean up with Object > Path > Simplify
an even, symmetrical inflation of a whole shape: the brush is local and hand-driven; Pucker & Bloat is uniform

review.changes: avoid: dropped 'linked files' (not among the objects Illustrator documents as liquify-proof, and outlining does not apply to them); script_api: example value d_factor 60 is not in the harvest; now a positive placeholder N; second pass 2026-10-06 re-checked every id, key, shortcut and equivalent against the batch and harvest: no further changes

cards.name: Crystallize
cards.summary: Liquify brush that adds random spiky details to the outline of vector paths: the edge under the brush is broken into sharp, crystal-like spikes and points that radiate out from the cursor, more of them the longer you hold. It edits the path geometry directly. (The harvest paired the display name with this id by Keyboard Shortcuts dialog order only, with no shortcut or word match; the id itself, spelled 'Cyrstallize', names the same tool.)
cards.how: Pick Crystallize from the Width tool flyout. Select the objects to change first; otherwise every unlocked object under the brush is affected. Press and hold, or drag, over the outline; the spikes build up while the mouse button is down. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush. Double-click the tool icon for the options: brush width, height, angle and intensity, plus Complexity (how many spikes), Detail, and whether the brush moves anchor points, in-tangent and/or out-tangent handles.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Cyrstallize Tool") only activates the tool; copy the id exactly, it is misspelled ('Cyrstallize') in Illustrator itself. The spiky brush stroke has no DOM call. Scripted substitutes for a spiky edge over the whole object: the Pucker & Bloat live effect with a negative value (harvest id 'Live Pucker & Bloat'), or Roughen with Corner points (harvest id 'Live Roughen') via item.applyEffect.
use_for: starburst, splat and explosion shapes for sale badges and comic graphics
ice, crystal and shattered-edge outlines
spiky fur, thorny or prickly edges on illustrations
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
a regular star or burst with even points: use the Star tool or the Pucker & Bloat / Zig Zag effects, which are uniform and live
clean production files: the spikes add many anchor points; simplify afterwards
Effect > Pixelate > Crystallize: same name, but that is a raster cell filter, not an outline distortion

review.changes: avoid: dropped 'linked files' (not among the objects Illustrator documents as liquify-proof, and outlining does not apply to them); summary: the harvest error says the name was paired by Keyboard Shortcuts dialog order, not toolbar order; corrected; second pass 2026-10-06 re-checked every id, key, shortcut and equivalent against the batch and harvest: no further changes

cards.name: Pucker
cards.summary: Liquify brush that deflates vector paths: anchor points under the circular brush are pulled toward the cursor centre, so the edge sucks in toward the cursor, pinching dents into a shape or drawing points inward into sharp, pinched spikes. The effect grows while the mouse button is held and is baked into the path.
cards.how: Pick Pucker from the Width tool flyout. Select the target objects first; with no selection every unlocked object under the brush is distorted. Press and hold over the outline (longer = stronger pinch) or drag along it. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush; double-click the tool icon for brush width, height, angle, intensity, pressure pen and the Detail / Simplify point settings. Brush centre inside a shape pulls the edge in (a dent); centre just outside drags the edge out toward it.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Pucker Tool") only activates the tool; the brushed pinch has no DOM call. Scripted substitute for a whole-object pucker: the Pucker & Bloat live effect with a negative value, item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Punk and Bloat"><Dict data="R d_factor N"/></LiveEffect>') with N negative (the Pucker side; harvest id 'Live Pucker & Bloat', key d_factor), or move PathPoint anchors toward a centre by script.
use_for: pinched waists and dents in organic shapes and characters
pulling points of an outline into thin, pinched spikes (petals, splashes)
local hand-tuned shaping of logo marks and icons
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
a uniform, symmetrical pucker of the whole object, or one that must stay editable: use Effect > Distort & Transform > Pucker & Bloat (negative value)
final print artwork without cleanup: extra anchor points pile up; run Object > Path > Simplify

review.changes: avoid: dropped 'linked files' (not among the objects Illustrator documents as liquify-proof, and outlining does not apply to them); script_api: example value d_factor -60 is not in the harvest; now a negative placeholder N; second pass 2026-10-06 re-checked every id, key, shortcut and equivalent against the batch and harvest: no further changes

cards.name: Scallop
cards.summary: Liquify brush that adds random curved details to the outline of vector paths: the edge under the brush is pulled toward the cursor centre in a series of curved arcs and fan-like folds, giving a scalloped, shell- or frill-like rim. Details build up while the mouse button is held and are baked into the path.
cards.how: Pick Scallop from the Width tool flyout. Select the objects to change first; otherwise every unlocked object under the brush is affected. Press and hold, or drag, over the outline. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush. Double-click the tool icon for brush width, height, angle and intensity, plus Complexity (how many curves), Detail, and whether the brush affects anchor points, in-tangent and/or out-tangent handles.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Scallop Tool") only activates the tool; the brushed scallop has no DOM call. A script can only approximate the look over a whole object, e.g. the Zig Zag live effect with Smooth points (harvest id 'Live Zig Zag') or Pucker & Bloat (harvest id 'Live Pucker & Bloat') via item.applyEffect; neither reproduces the local, random arcs.
use_for: seashell, frill and ruffled-edge shapes
organic, wavy rims on flowers, leaves and decorative badges
hand-made, irregular edges on illustration elements
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
an even, regular scalloped border: draw it from repeated circles or use Zig Zag with Smooth points, which is uniform and live
clean production files: many anchor points are added; simplify afterwards

cards.name: Twirl
cards.summary: Liquify brush that creates swirling distortions: the part of a vector path under the circular brush is rotated around the cursor centre, winding the outline into a spiral that gets more turns the longer the mouse button is held. The twist is baked into the path.
cards.how: Pick Twirl from the Width tool flyout. Select the objects to change first; otherwise every unlocked object under the brush is affected. Press and hold over the area to twirl (the swirl keeps winding while you hold) or drag to smear the swirl along the path. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush. Double-click the tool icon for brush width, height, angle, intensity and the Twirl Rate, whose value sets the speed and its sign the direction of rotation, plus Detail / Simplify.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe New Twirl Tool") only activates the tool; the brushed swirl has no DOM call. Scripted substitute for a whole-object twist: the Twist live effect, item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Twirl"><Dict data="R angle A"/></LiveEffect>') with A the twist angle in degrees, sign = direction (harvest id 'Live Twist', key angle); it rotates around the object's centre, not a chosen spot.
use_for: swirls and curls in hair, smoke, waves and flourishes
psychedelic or hypnotic twisted lettering (after outlining)
spiral accents on decorative and pattern elements
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
a twist that must stay editable or centred on the object: use Effect > Distort & Transform > Twist
precise spirals: draw with the Spiral tool instead
final artwork without cleanup: the swirl adds many points; simplify afterwards

cards.name: Warp
cards.summary: Liquify brush that molds vector paths like clay: dragging the circular brush pushes the outline in the direction of the drag, stretching edges into smooth lobes and spurs or pushing dents in. The change is baked into the path geometry.
cards.how: Press Shift+R or pick Warp from the Width tool flyout. Select the objects to change first; with no selection every unlocked object under the brush gets pushed. Drag across or along an edge to push it in the drag direction; short repeated strokes give more control than one long one. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush. Double-click the tool icon for brush width, height, angle, intensity, pressure pen and Detail / Simplify, which decide how many anchor points the push adds.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Warp Tool") only activates the tool; the push stroke has no DOM call. Scripted substitutes: app.executeMenuCommand('Make Warp') (Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp, which opens the 'Warp Options' dialog) or an Effect > Warp live effect via item.applyEffect (live effect 'Adobe Deform', e.g. harvest id 'Live Deform Bulge'), which bend the whole object with a preset shape, or editing PathPoint.anchor / leftDirection / rightDirection directly.
use_for: hand-molding organic shapes, characters and blobs
melting, dripping and wobbly distortions of outlined lettering
quick fluid tweaks to illustrations without editing points one by one
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
an editable bend of the whole object: use Object > Envelope Distort > Make with Warp or Make with Mesh
precise geometric edits: move anchor points with the Direct Selection tool
final artwork without cleanup: dense anchor points; run Object > Path > Simplify

review.changes: avoid: dropped 'linked files' (not among the objects Illustrator documents as liquify-proof, and outlining does not apply to them); script_api: Make Warp is a menu command that opens the 'Warp Options' dialog (harvest), said so; named the harvested Warp live effect ('Adobe Deform', 'Live Deform Bulge') instead of an unnamed 'Warp effect'; second pass 2026-10-06 re-checked every id, key, shortcut and equivalent against the batch and harvest: no further changes

cards.name: Width Tool
cards.summary: Gives a stroke a variable width: you drag width points out from or in toward the path so the line swells, tapers or is thicker on one side, like an inked or calligraphic line. The stroke stays a live, editable stroke on the original path, and the result can be saved as a reusable width profile.
cards.how: Press Shift+W (it sits in both the Default and the Basic toolbar). Hover a stroked path: drag away from or toward the path to widen or narrow the stroke equally on both sides at that spot, which adds a width point; Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) changes only one side. Drag a width point along the path to move it, Alt-drag it to copy it, select it and press Delete to remove it. Double-click a width point for the Width Point Edit dialog (numeric side 1 / side 2 / total width). Save the shape from the Stroke panel's Profile menu to reuse it on other strokes.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Width Tool") only activates the tool; the DOM has no call that adds or moves width points. Scripted alternatives: set PathItem.strokeWidth for a uniform width, apply a saved graphic style carrying a profiled stroke with GraphicStyle.applyTo(item) (ApplyTo is in the harvested type library, class:GraphicStyle; that a style carries the width profile was not tested), or build the shape as a filled outline. The six built-in profiles ('Width Profile 1'..'Width Profile 6', Stroke panel/Profile) are presets, not script calls.
use_for: hand-drawn, inked look for line illustrations and icons
tapered strokes for calligraphic logo marks and monoline lettering with contrast
swelling decorative lines, swashes and dividers
one-sided bulges such as leaf, flame or brush-stroke shapes that stay editable
avoid: files going to apps or cutters that read only plain paths: Object > Expand Appearance (or Outline Stroke) converts the stroke to a filled shape first
batch or scripted work: width points cannot be set by script; use filled shapes or a saved graphic style
pressure-sensitive freehand lettering: the Paintbrush with a calligraphic brush or the Blob Brush is faster

review.changes: script_api: GraphicStyle.ApplyTo is in the harvest (ai_api class:GraphicStyle), so 'not harvest-verified' was wrong; the untested part is now named precisely; second pass 2026-10-06 re-checked every id, key, shortcut and equivalent against the batch and harvest: no further changes

cards.name: Wrinkle
cards.summary: Liquify brush that adds random, wrinkle-like details to the outline of vector paths: the edge under the brush is jittered into irregular jagged ripples, like crumpled paper, torn cloth or a rough coastline. Details build up while the mouse button is held and are baked into the path.
cards.how: Pick Wrinkle from the Width tool flyout. Select the objects to change first; otherwise every unlocked object under the brush is affected. Press and hold, or drag, over the outline. Alt-drag (Option-drag on Mac) resizes the brush. Double-click the tool icon for brush width, height, angle and intensity, plus Horizontal and Vertical (how far points may move in each direction), Complexity, Detail, and whether the brush affects anchor points, in-tangent and/or out-tangent handles.
cards.script_api: app.selectTool("Adobe Wrinkle Tool") only activates the tool; the brushed wrinkle has no DOM call. Scripted substitute for a rough edge over the whole object: the Roughen live effect, item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe Roughen"><Dict data="R roundness 0 R absoluteness 0 R size 5 R asiz 5 R dtal 10"/></LiveEffect>') (harvest id 'Live Roughen').
use_for: torn-paper, crumpled and distressed edges on badges and labels
rough coastlines, rocks, bark and fabric folds in illustrations
local hand-made roughness on part of an outline only
avoid: live type, symbols and graphs: the liquify tools do not work on them; outline the type or expand first
even roughness over the whole object or one that must stay editable: use Effect > Distort & Transform > Roughen
clean production files: many anchor points are added; simplify afterwards
